notes: The down of Look down is read as the phrasal particle of the hiphil of šāqap̄, leaving the paragogic he unrepresented; the competing reading would give down to that he, but MACULA tags it Sh rather than Sd, and rule 32's directive case reaches only an Sd.
mᵉʿôn qoḏšᵉkā is rendered attributively as thy holy habitation, following the ASV rather than imposing rule 19 (rule 28).
